description: We are a team from Qaiwan International University (QIU), Sulaymaniyah, participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. Our goal is to develop an innovative health-monitoring software solution to support astronauts during space missions. Our interests include programming, artificial intelligence, data analysis, and software design. We welcome passionate students and creative thinkers who enjoy teamwork, solving real-world problems, and exploring space technology.
